```{python}
#| label: fig-synth-opt-pipeline
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "(a) Pipelining: a register in the middle of the logic halves the longest path between two registers, and the operand `x`, which enters the second half, needs a pipeline register as well. The result appears one clock cycle later. (b) Retiming: the register R2 moves backwards across the logic block B, and the longest path shrinks from 3 to 2 ns, while the function at the outputs stays the same. The delays are examples, without the clock-to-output delay and the setup time."
#| fig-alt: "Four rows of block diagrams with registers as narrow blue boxes and logic as green boxes. Row a, before: register R1 drives logic A (2 ns) and logic B (2 ns) in series into register R2, and an operand x from a second input register enters B, longest path 4 ns. Row a, after: a pipeline register sits between A and B, and x passes through its own pipeline register before B, longest path 2 ns, one more cycle of latency. Row b, before: R1, logic A (2 ns), logic B (1 ns), register R2, logic C (1 ns), register R3, longest path 3 ns. Row b, after: R1, logic A (2 ns), register R2, logic B (1 ns), logic C (1 ns), register R3, longest path 2 ns."
import schemdraw as sd
from schemdraw import flow
from schemdraw import elements as elm
sd.svgconfig.svg2 = False

BLUE, BLUE_L = '#6c8ebf', '#dae8fc'
GREEN, GREEN_L = '#82b366', '#d5e8d4'
RW, RH = 0.45, 1.3    # register box
LH = 0.9              # logic box height


def reg(x, y, name='', color=BLUE, fill=BLUE_L):
    ''' Register centered at (x, y), returns (input, output) '''
    flow.Box(w=RW, h=RH).at((x, y)).anchor('center').fill(fill).color(color)
    xl, yb = x - RW/2, y - RH/2
    flow.Line().at((xl, yb + 0.35)).to((xl + 0.15, yb + 0.25)).color('black')
    flow.Line().at((xl + 0.15, yb + 0.25)).to((xl, yb + 0.15)).color('black')
    if name:
        elm.Label().at((x, y + RH/2 + 0.38)).label(name, color='black')
    return (xl, y), (x + RW/2, y)


def logic(x, y, w, text):
    ''' Logic block with its left edge at x, returns (input, output) '''
    flow.Box(w=w, h=LH).at((x + w/2, y)).anchor('center').fill(GREEN_L).color(GREEN) \
        .label(text, color='black')
    return (x, y), (x + w, y)


def chain(y, items):
    ''' Draw registers ('R', name) and logic ('L', width, text) left to right '''
    x, prev = 0.6, None
    for it in items:
        if it[0] == 'R':
            x += RW/2
            i, o = reg(x, y, it[1], *(it[2:] if len(it) > 2 else ()))
            x += RW/2
        else:
            i, o = logic(x, y, it[1], it[2])
            x += it[1]
        if prev is None:
            flow.Arrow().at((0, y)).to(i)
        else:
            flow.Arrow().at(prev).to(i)
        prev = o
        x += 0.6
    flow.Arrow().at(prev).to((prev[0] + 0.5, y))
    return x


def side(y, text):
    elm.Label().at((12.2, y)).label(text, halign='left', color='black')


PIPE = ('#b85450', '#f8cecc')   # pipeline register, red
with sd.Drawing(canvas='svg') as d:
    d.config(unit=1, fontsize=11, lw=1.5, bgcolor='white')
    elm.Label().at((-0.5, 1.4)).label('(a)', halign='left', color='black')
    y = 0
    chain(y, [('R', 'R1'), ('L', 2.6, 'A\n2 ns'), ('L', 2.6, 'B\n2 ns'), ('R', 'R2')])
    i, o = reg(0.6 + RW/2, y - 1.8)
    flow.Arrow().at((0, y - 1.8)).to(i)
    elm.Label().at((-0.25, y - 1.8)).label('x', color='black')
    xb = 0.6 + RW + 0.6 + 2.6 + 0.6 + 1.3
    flow.Line().at(o).to((xb, y - 1.8))
    flow.Arrow().at((xb, y - 1.8)).to((xb, y - LH/2))
    side(y, 'longest path 4 ns')

    y = -4.2
    chain(y, [('R', 'R1'), ('L', 2.6, 'A\n2 ns'), ('R', '', *PIPE), ('L', 2.6, 'B\n2 ns'),
              ('R', 'R2')])
    i, o = reg(0.6 + RW/2, y - 1.8)
    flow.Arrow().at((0, y - 1.8)).to(i)
    elm.Label().at((-0.25, y - 1.8)).label('x', color='black')
    xp = 0.6 + RW + 0.6 + 2.6 + 0.6 + RW/2
    i2, o2 = reg(xp, y - 1.8, '', *PIPE)
    flow.Arrow().at(o).to(i2)
    xb = xp + RW/2 + 0.6 + 1.3
    flow.Line().at(o2).to((xb, y - 1.8))
    flow.Arrow().at((xb, y - 1.8)).to((xb, y - LH/2))
    side(y, 'longest path 2 ns,\none cycle more latency')

    elm.Label().at((-0.5, -7.4)).label('(b)', halign='left', color='black')
    y = -8.8
    chain(y, [('R', 'R1'), ('L', 2.6, 'A\n2 ns'), ('L', 1.6, 'B\n1 ns'), ('R', 'R2'),
              ('L', 1.6, 'C\n1 ns'), ('R', 'R3')])
    side(y, 'longest path 3 ns')
    y = -11.0
    chain(y, [('R', 'R1'), ('L', 2.6, 'A\n2 ns'), ('R', 'R2'), ('L', 1.6, 'B\n1 ns'),
              ('L', 1.6, 'C\n1 ns'), ('R', 'R3')])
    side(y, 'longest path 2 ns')
```
